doc.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006

title: Evan Thomas, the Crowley trumpeter Armstrong feared
summary: Local legend of Evan Thomas, a Crowley trumpeter said to scare Louis Armstrong, killed before Jordan was born.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: But as far as traditional music is concerned I didn’t really get into that. I mean they had people playing that but I never did buy it. And then I guess what I was a little — see I was in southwest Louisiana. Now they had bands from down there. Have you ever heard of a trumpet player named Evan Thomas?
Nobody in your interviews that you ever interviewed said Evan Thomas? [pronounced eVHAN]

Evan Thomas. E-V-A-N. They may have called him Evan Thomas. But out in the country they called him Evan Thomas. He was supposed to be the trumpet player that Louis Armstrong was scared of. They tell me Louis Armstrong was more afraid of him than a pit of rattlesnakes. When Louis Armstrong got to Crowley he would pass it and go by. He was a hell of a player. Now he got killed before I was born but everybody being from Crowley, everybody used to talk about him and I found a picture, somebody gave me a picture in San Francisco last week or the week before last, with him playing in some of the New Orleans band like Pichon’s band and all of them. And everybody say he was a hell of a trumpet player.
I bet he’s in that, I just read a book by Pops Foster.
See if you can find Evan Thomas in it.
